title: autotune: defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce unit cost for common request patterns by shipping sane defaults and exposing a safe autotune path. This PR introduces three coordinated changes: 1) new server-side defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching tuned to production request distributions (reduces tail latency while improving throughput); 2) a set of quantization profile presets that are validated against our quality regression tests (fp16, int8-symmetric, int8-perchannel presets) and an API to reference them from model configs; 3) lightweight unit-economics (uecon) tooling to estimate per-token cost impact given batching/caching/quant profiles. The goal is to provide immediate cost wins for self-serve users and to enable Dedicated autoscaler to reason about cost vs performance during rollouts. Changes: - Add autotune/defaults.yaml containing recommended batching/caching defaults and rollout-safe thresholds. - Introduce quant_profiles/{fp16,int8_sym,int8_pc}.yaml and validation harness. - Implement uecon CLI/tooling at tools/uecon/ to compute per-token cost estimates from runtime telemetry. - Runtime changes in serving/batcher and serving/cache to honor new defaults and expose metrics used by uecon. - Expose new route-level config keys: auto_batch: true|false, prefix_cache: {enabled:bool, ttl_ms:int}, quant_profile: string. Testing: unit tests for autotune logic, integration tests against a small Llama-like model in the perf-canary harness, and quality regression suite comparing sample outputs across quant profiles. Deployment/Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag "autotune_defaults" and an org-level opt-in. Rollout plan includes canary on dedicated pools, metric watchlist (latency p95, token cost, generation quality delta), and automatic rollback if quality delta exceeds threshold. Related: Linear ENG-2987 (autotune defaults), ENG-3041 (uecon tooling). Checklist: [x] add defaults and profiles, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] docs, [x] changelog entry.

release_notes:
- Introduces autotune defaults for batching and prefix caching to improve throughput and reduce per-token cost.
- Adds validated quantization profiles (fp16, int8 symmetric, int8 per-channel) with quality regression tests.
- Adds a basic unit-economics (uecon) tool to estimate per-token cost impact of batching/caching/quant choices.
- Feature gated; opt-in rollout for orgs with monitoring and rollback policies.
